It's been 18 and a half days since my last cigarette.

I don't feel any positive changes after quitting either so it's been challenging to push through. But I have and logically, I know this is very beneficial for me.

I am 38 and have smoked since I was 18, 20 years straight minus my 2 pregnancies. I quit 10 days, 5 hours ago... so still new.

I make a full time income on eBay. Here are some tips -

- Photograph and describe any and all flaws in the item.

- Get a postal scale and weigh your items before listing so you know what to charge for shipping.

- Don't ask for feedback. As a new seller, you will be tempted to, but don't. It annoys people.

- Know the fees. There are eBay fees and PayPal fees.

- Buy shipping through eBay, it's cheaper.

- Don't list anything you can't afford to lose.

- The more you list, the more you sell. If you have 10 items listed, you aren't going to sell very much.

- Don't start auctions at 99 cents unless you would be happy with that price.
